jobs.occupation: Principal Product Application Engineer (m/f/d) - SiC (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
About the role

As a Principal Product Application Engineer (m/f/d), you will work on developing and validating advanced SiC-based solutions, turning cutting-edge semiconductor technology into real-world applications. You will collaborate with global teams, support customers, and help drive new products to market, combining hands-on engineering with strong application insight.

What you will do

- Design power electronics platforms using SiC technologies
- Run and analyze testing and validation of power systems
- Build demo systems and present solutions to customers
- Support product go-to-market and customer design-in activities
- Create and deliver technical presentations, training, and webinars
- Help shape next-generation semiconductor performance through application insights
- Support device testing, characterization, and modelling
- Collaborate with internal teams, partners, and universities
- Work in a global, multicultural team

What you will bring

- M.Sc. Degree or higher in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or similar
- 5+ years in the semiconductor industry (power applications focus; WBG preferred)
- Strong experience in hardware design for SiC, GaN, and IGBT applications
- Knowledge of thermal/mechanical design, gate driving, and inductance optimization
- Skilled in measurements, testing, and high-voltage lab environments
- Solid experience with PCB design, simulation, and power module design
- Able to connect device physics, converter design, and customer needs
- Good communication skills; fluent in English (German is a plus)
- Hands-on approach and willingness to travel occasionally

jobs.occupation: (Sr.) Product Manager (m/f/d) – ESD Protection & Filtering (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
About the job

As a Product Manager, you will own and drive the success of a defined product portfolio, combining strategic thinking with strong market and customer focus. Positioned between Regional Marketing and Product Group Leadership, you will translate market insights, customer needs, and business strategy into actionable product decisions. You will work closely with cross-functional teams - including R&D, Marketing, Sales, and Operations - to ensure that products are competitively positioned, financially successful, and aligned with long-term portfolio objectives.

What you will do

- Portfolio owner for automotive ESD/TVS and PowerTVS within the Product Group Protection & Filtering
- Define and execute product strategies across the full product lifecycle (from ideation to end-of-life) while monitoring product performance and support delivery of revenue and profitability targets
- Analyze markets, applications, customer needs, and competitors to identify growth opportunities
- Develop and maintain product roadmaps aligned with portfolio and business goals
- Build, evaluate, and drive business cases for new product opportunities including business case fulfillment
- Collaborate with R&D, Marketing, Sales, and Operations to ensure aligned execution
- Support New Product Introduction (NPI) with clear value propositions and go-to-market plans
- Drive product positioning, pricing, and portfolio optimization
- Contribute to marketing content and product communication materials

What you will need

- Minimum master’s degree in industrial engineering, electrical engineering or semiconductor device physics
- Minimum 5 years of experience in product management, product marketing, sales or business development (ideally in semiconductor or high-tech domain)
- Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills
- Ability to translate technical and market insights into actionable strategies
- Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder (internal/external) management skills
- Experience working in cross-functional and international teams
- Entrepreneurial mindset with strong customer and value focus
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Willingness to travel (low frequency)
- Fluent English (additional languages are a plus)

This is your new job

- Work closely with the business team on finance planning & budgeting data preparation & consolidation and conduct regular reviews together with relevant business stakeholders
- Financial process tasks support, incl. Month-End-Closing (MEC), Quarter-End-Closing (QEC) and Year-End-Closing (YEC)
- Financial controlling reporting, incl. forecast planning report, quarterly finance rolling forecast reporting, monthly/quarterly forecast vs. actual variance detailed analysis & reporting on findings
- Collaborate closely with key business stakeholders across Business Groups (BGs), managing R&D project budget and cost tracking, and supporting new project ROI analysis and fulfilment reviews
- Conduct business case validation with project, marketing, and controlling teams, including data-driven comparisons, IRR analysis, investment risk assessment, and presenting insights and recommendations to the management team.
- Support long-term strategic planning, including participation in business strategy discussions and finance data consolidation/reporting
- Support BG key projects in in-house CAPEX investment ROI evaluation, as well as fixed asset management, including budget control, cost tracking, and reporting
- Support Finance projects, particularly cross-BG standardization, reporting automation projects, government subsidy application support (including business case evaluation), and BG internal control process utilization projects.
- Assist with daily finance operations and other ad-hoc finance tasks

This is you

- University degree in Finance, Accounting or Economics, preferably with Accounting/Financial Management Major.
- Min 5 years of relevant working experience in an Accounting or Corporate Finance position in an international corporate environment.
- Experience in a Multinational Company within the semiconductor or related industry is highly preferred
- Fast learner, willing to take challenges and could handle pressure and complete work in timeline
- Skilled in Office tools, PowerPoint, SAP or other ERP platform experience, good excel/data analysis skill is preferred
- Strong communication skills and a collaborative team spirit, particularly in cross-functional and cross-regional environments
- Fluency in English is a must (written and spoken)
- Openness to occasional business travel (10%)

Job Description

About the job

As Business Product Manager you will maximize revenue and profitability of an existing family or families of products within a Product Group’s portfolio. You own the Pricing and Go to Market (G2M) strategy for running portfolios.

The role requires profound knowledge and experience in pricing strategies, channel management and negotiation. Furthermore, a strong ability to manage a complex network of internal and external stakeholders, including customers is required.

What you will do

- Drive revenue and profitability of the assigned product segment by being hungry and willing to win in a challenging and dynamic business environment
- Be the business partner for Business Group (BG) Marketing and Global Sales & Marketing (GSM) in the assigned product portfolio (manufacturing strategy, benefits, longevity etc.)
- Develop key customer & channel strategies together with Product Group Head, Business Marketing Managers, Product Marketing Managers and GSM
- Own the pricing tactics and quote policies for all sales channels for Commercial Marketing in alignment with Product Marketing Managers, Business Marketing Managers and in line with overall Product Group target settings
- Build & maintain G2M material
- Competitor analysis: consolidate input from regions about competitor behaviors, especially pricing strategy at Distribution and OEM channel, inputting (to Industrial) for required cost down roadmaps to reach Product Group margin targets
- Forecasting: align with Demand Management in line with forecast process
- Manage pricing strategy, price setting and special offers for business via Distribution partners
- Drive design-in/design-win success through organizing necessary support to BG Marketing and GSM
- Establish and maintain relationships with key customers and partners in alignment with BG Marketing and GSM.

What you will need

- University degree in electrical and electronic engineering or other related discipline
- Min. 5 years’ experience in Product Marketing or Product Management in the Semiconductor industry
- Proven track record of product (lifecycle) management, with strong understanding of market trends and customer needs, preferably with exposure to international customers
- Strong individual accountability, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
- Ability to establish lasting relationships and networks in a complex environment across different levels of hierarchies and various stakeholders in a multiple culture environment
- Direct work experience with Power semiconductors or previous experience in product line is preferred
- Knowledge of key business metrics and strong negotiation skills
- Business fluent in English (written and spoken), any other language is a plus
- Willingness to travel occasionally

jobs.occupation: Head of T&O Controlling (m/f/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule) - Rechnungswesen und Controlling)
jobs.description:
About the role

As Head of T&O Controlling, you will lead a global team of finance professionals and be responsible for all financial planning, reporting, forecasting, and governance activities across the T&O organization. Acting as a trusted business partner to the COO, CFO, and senior leadership team, you will provide strategic financial insights, drive investment and performance decisions, and ensure robust controls, compliance, and operational excellence across all T&O sites.

This is your new role

- Lead and develop the Global T&O Controlling team (40+FTEs), including performance management, coaching, and capability building.
- Own the delivery of central T&O financial reporting, ensuring timely, accurate and consistent reporting across all T&O Sites.
- Provide executive‑level financial insights, turning data into clear narratives and recommendations for the COO, CFO, and senior leadership.
- Own execution of the T&O planning calendar and governance, driving consistency, accuracy, and alignment across all financial cycles (Budget, RFF, Strategic Plan).
- Lead financial analysis and support strategic projects. Ensuring business cases assess opportunities available across different scenarios and drive effective decision making within the project teams.
- Drive the CAPEX process, ensuring effective and efficient processes and procedures in place to support the business making the right investment decisions, and projects are held accountable for post investment performance.
- Ensure accurate forecasting of Capex and Opex commitments for business planning.
- Ensure effective business controls and standardized processes are in place to cover all T&O cycles, drive compliance with Nexperia SOPs and ensure controls are robust, effective and efficient.
- Serve as a key member of the T&O management team, supporting the COO and Management Team drive improvements in all areas of T&O performance.

This is you

- University degree in Finance, Accounting, Controlling, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
- Professional qualifications as an MBA, CPA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent are an advantage
- Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in Finance and related Business processes such as Manufacturing, Supply Chain Management etc.
- Proven track record of leading and developing high-performing global teams, driving performance management, talent development, and organizational capability building
- Excellent understanding of financial controls, governance frameworks, compliance requirements, and process standardization, ensuring robust and efficient operating practices across global organizations
- Proven stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships at executive level, challenge constructively, drive change, and support strategic decision-making in a fast-paced environment
- Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken) are essential, with the ability to present complex financial information clearly and confidently to international senior stakeholders; additional languages are considered a plus

The Senior/Principal Application Engineer will drive the development of reference designs and

application boards with a strong focus on Industrial motor-control and motor-drive applications

that showcase Nexperia’s portfolio. This position is part of our System and Application Team and

plays a critical role in bridging product development and customer requirements by translating

device capabilities into practical, production ready hardware solutions

The role is central to enabling customer adoption and accelerating time-to-market through high

quality design collaterals, hands-on validation and technical support

IHRE HAUPTAUFGABEN

• Design, develop, and validate reference designs and application boards using Nexperia’s

discrete, analog, and power IC solutions

• Create schematics, perform component selection, and collaborate on PCB layout to optimize

performance, efficiency, cost, thermal behavior, and reliability

• Perform comprehensive electrical, thermal, and system-level validation, including efficiency

analysis, switching characterization, transient response testing, thermal profiling, and

EMI/EMC pre-compliance evaluation and troubleshooting

• Provide application-focused technical support to customers and sales teams by

troubleshooting designs, supporting design-in activities, participating in customer

engagements, and representing Nexperia at workshops, conferences, and exhibitions

• Create and maintain high-quality technical collateral such as application notes, design guides,

simulation models, user manuals, and web-based application content

• Build deep application expertise and translate customer insights into future product

opportunities by collaborating with marketing, R&D, and system architects to define

requirements, identify use cases, and contribute to product roadmap development

IHR PROFIL

• Education/ studies: BSEE. MSEE preferred

• Min 5 years of experience in application engineering, hardware design or power electronics

• Proven experience developing reference designs or evaluation boards for various types of

machine drives: stepper motors, brushed DC motors, BLDCs, PMSMs and induction drives

• Experience in Robotics and Automation Systems is a strong advantage

• Strong understanding of three-phase power systems, inverter topologies,

• Switching behaviour, losses and efficiency optimization

• Technical experience in PCB design and layout – Altium, KiCad

• Familiarity with simulation tools and industry standards - Matlab/Simulink, LT Spice, Plecs,

Thermal analysis, EMC compatibility

• Strong analytical and system-level thinking

• Hands-on, problem-solving mindset with attention to detail

• Ability to work in cross-functional and global teams

• Customer focused approach with strong ownership

• Excellent presentation and technical writing skills

• English business fluent verbal and written, German nice to have.

As a (Senior) Process Development Engineer (m/f/d), you will play a key role in advancing competitive silicon-based discrete power technologies, driving innovation from process development to industrial manufacturing.

Working in a cross-functional environment with product, production and quality engineering teams, you will develop and industrialize robust wafer fabrication processes that enable cost-efficient, scalable and high-performance semiconductor products.

You will act as a process architect within development projects, translating product requirements into manufacturable process concepts and ensuring successful transfer into stable, automotive-qualified production.

This is your new job

- Define and integrate robust, scalable wafer fabrication flows by combining and optimizing unit processes
- Own and drive end-to-end process development from concept to stable high-volume manufacturing within cross-functional projects
- Ensure manufacturability and industrial readiness, including alignment with production, quality and automotive qualification requirements
- Optimize and balance process performance (yield, cost, quality, robustness) to meet competitive product and manufacturing targets
- Act as key technical interface between development and production, driving cross-functional alignment and sustainable solutions
- Benchmark competitor technologies and derive actionable insights for technology development
- Build and leverage expert networks to support technology development and continuously deepen process know-how

This is you

- Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics or a related field
- Several years of relevant experience in semiconductor process development are preferred
- Solid understanding of semiconductor devices and industrial wafer fabrication processes, preferably for discrete power devices
- Hands-on experience in wafer processing and related equipment
- Strong analytical skills and ability to solve complex technical problems in a structured and result-oriented way
- Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and international teams
- Strong sense of ownership and accountability for technical outcomes
- Good organizational and planning skills with a structured working style
- Fluent in English and German, both written and spoken

About the role

As a Procurement Specialist within Nexperia’s Global Procurement organisation, you will lead the Equipment Parts & Services (EPS) category for our Hamburg and Manchester manufacturing sites. This is a high‑impact role managing a diverse, global supplier base, ranging from daily‑touch strategic partners to niche suppliers engaged once every few years.

You will directly own and manage relationships around 100 key suppliers at an average annual spend of around $40m. You will also act as a primary commercial interface for up to 500 suppliers across all equipment parts and services for both manufacturing sites. The work is varied, fast‑paced, and strategically significant no two weeks look the same.

This role offers a great chance to develop your Procurement skillset within a fast paced, high tech global company with occasional international travel for collaboration purposes.

Key Responsibilities include

- Sourcing Strategy Leadership  - Drive and lead sourcing strategies that deliver competitive cost structures and long‑term value for EPS categories
- Stakeholder Collaboration -  Shape requirements with engineering, operations, and site teams, providing commercial insight and value‑creation opportunities
- Market & Spend Analysis -  Conduct market research, analyse spend categories, and apply insights to negotiation and sourcing strategies
- Global Negotiation Leadership - Lead complex commercial negotiations with cross‑functional, international teams; develop negotiation plans for high‑value global projects
- Supplier Performance Management - Manage supplier performance across quality, cost, delivery, technology, and service to maintain a best‑in‑class supply base
- Contract Ownership - Draft, negotiate, and manage supplier contracts to secure optimal terms and mitigate commercial risk
- Project Delivery -  Lead global sourcing projects, including scope creation, negotiation planning, and delivery of measurable results
- Operational Excellence-  Drive adoption of procurement tools, processes, and continuous improvement initiatives across EPS activities

This is you

Essential requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree level education or equivalent experience
- 3+ years of procurement experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment
- Experience of participation or leading cross site commodity and international procurement projects
- Strong Negotiation and Analytical Skills
- Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
- Team player and a hands-on worker
- Ability to prioritize and work on multiple activities at one time
- Ability to work independently and with autonomy
- SAP, Ariba, MS Excel, PowerPoint presentation and data analytical skills
- Strong teamwork and collaboration skills on an international level

The Nexperia European Purchasing team is seeking a driven and dedicated Procurement Specialist with a focus on Direct materials (Specialist chemicals and gases) used during the manufacturing process for sites based in the UK and Germany. This position will provide you with the opportunity to work with varying stakeholders in the Production, Engineering, Environmental and Quality teams across both sites whilst building effective relationships with global suppliers.

What you will do:

As a Procurement Specialist for Direct manufacturing materials, you will work on a Hybrid basis at one of our front-end manufacturing sites in either Manchester UK or Hamburg Germany. This position plays a critical role in ensuring that procurement processes, controls and supplier management activities operate effectively and efficiently. You will support both local and global sourcing initiatives, driving cost optimisation, supplier performance and overall strategic procurement execution. Being part of a global company, you will also get the chance to support Global Sourcing Managers in the implementation of commodity sourcing strategies on site, enhancing your development pathways at Nexperia.

Key Responsibilities Include:

Sourcing & Supplier Management

- Identify, assess, and onboard suppliers to support operational and development needs.
- Support Global Sourcing Managers with the negotiation and procurement of BOM materials, including metal commodities, and ensure effective implementation of POs, consignment, and contracts.
- Manage supplier performance across quality, cost, delivery, technology, and service to maintain a high‑performing, competitive supply base.
- Ensure continuous supply is maintained into the Sites

Strategic Procurement & Market Insight

- Contribute to the execution of commodity sourcing strategies at site level, ensuring alignment with global procurement objectives.
- Conduct market research and analyse spend categories to inform negotiation strategies and drive value creation.
- Provide commercial insights to stakeholders, ensuring requirements are met while maintaining a competitive sourcing environment.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration & Project Delivery

- Partner with Supply Chain, Engineering, and Production teams to deliver annual cost‑reduction and sourcing project targets.
- Support project management activities, including supplier onboarding, qualification sample coordination, and new development communication.
- Ensure effective alignment between suppliers and internal teams to support operational and development programmes.

Process Ownership & Continuous Improvement

- Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of efficient end‑to‑end procurement processes and strong internal controls.
- Benchmark procurement practices against industry leaders and drive strategic initiatives to achieve operational excellence.

What you will need

**Essential requirements:**

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Procurement, Supply Chain, or a related field
- Minimum 3 years’ procurement experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment with direct materials
- Strong negotiation, stakeholder management, and relationship‑building skills
- Confident analysing and presenting numerical data, with strong problem‑solving ability
- Effective communicator with excellent English skills and the ability to collaborate across countries and time zones
- Skilled in SAP, Excel, PowerPoint, and data analysis tools
- Able to prioritise, adapt quickly, and work with urgency in a fast‑paced environment
- Experience in process improvement, change management, and driving cross‑functional collaboration.

Desirable experience:

- Exposure to the Semiconductor Industry
- Experience working with chemicals, gases or technical procurement

jobs.occupation: Senior Logistics Coordinator & Import/Export Analyst (m/f/d) (Fachkraft - Logistik/Materialwirtschaft)
jobs.description:
At Azenta Life Sciences, we support some of the world's leading pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and research organizations by managing the samples and materials that underpin scientific discovery.

Join our Griesheim Biobank team as EU Sample Management Coordinator (Logistics Coordinator & Import/Export Analyst).

How You´ll Add Value

As EU Sample Management Coordinator (m/w/d), you will coordinate the shipment of biological samples, laboratory materials, and related goods throughout Europe and internationally. In this role, you will also help ensure compliance with applicable customs, import/export, and trade regulations by supporting the accurate preparation, review, and coordination of shipment documentation and related processes.

The role offers a combination of hands-on logistics coordination, customs administration, customer communication, and process improvement. Success in this position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while ensuring shipments meet internal standards and external regulatory requirements.

This is an opportunity to join an established international organization and play a key role in supporting scientific and clinical research projects across Europe.

What You´ll Do

- You are part of a four-person logistics team that serves as the central point of contact for logistics matters across our operations, as well as for customers and service providers.
- You coordinate and manage shipping orders in day-to-day operations, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant execution.
- Your routine tasks include packaging and labeling goods ready for shipment, as well as preparing cover letters, freight documents, and customs documentation.
- You support import and export compliance activities, including reviewing shipment data for customs relevance, helping ensure correct classification, documentation completeness, and adherence to internal procedures and applicable regulations.
- You are responsible for coordinating with customs authorities, brokers, and other relevant parties to ensure smooth border crossings, including in time-critical cases.
- You help monitor and maintain records related to import/export activities and support internal compliance checks, audits, and process documentation updates where required.
- You support the continuous development of our logistics processes and service offerings, including with a focus on compliance, efficiency, and sustainability.
- You also support incoming goods processing when needed, checking for completeness and informing the relevant departments, for example in the case of deliveries of chemicals and reagents.
- Additionally, you are responsible for inventory, as well as managing and ordering logistics-related materials.
- You understand and strictly adhere to standard operating procedures (SOPs) in English and contribute to maintaining high ethical and quality standards in all shipment-related activities.

What You´ll Bring

- Successfully completed vocational training or a degree in business administration, logistics, customs, or a similar qualification.
- Practical work experience in logistics, customs, import/export, or within a freight forwarding company.
- Sound understanding of customs clearance processes, shipping documentation, and import/export compliance requirements; experience with dangerous goods is a plus.
- Familiarity with trade compliance topics such as tariff classification, country of origin, customs value, restricted party screening, or license-related checks is an advantage.
- Very good communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Reliability clearance in accordance with Section 7 of the German Aviation Security Act (LuftSiG).
- Team player with enthusiasm for working in an international team.
- Proficient in standard MS Office software; advanced Excel skills and familiarity with ERP systems are an advantage.
- Forward-thinking and solution-oriented approach to work, with a strong awareness of compliance and best practices.
- Strong hands-on mentality.
- Attention to detail and excellent prioritization skills.
- Fluent in German and English (B2 level or higher).

What We Offer

- Become part of a company that contributes to groundbreaking scientific developments and therapies.
- Positive company culture and strong teamwork across all locations.
- Individual development opportunities to strengthen your international competencies and language skills.
- Attractive workplace in Griesheim with excellent transport connections.
- 30 days of annual leave to support a healthy work-life balance.
- Partnership with pme Familienservice to support employees in all life situations.
- Additional benefits include a stock purchase program, life insurance, company pension scheme, profit sharing, five additional childcare sick days, and a corporate benefits online shopping platform.

Contact

Azenta Germany GmbH

Im Leuschnerpark 1b

64347 Griesheim

About Nexperia

At Nexperia, legal expertise is a key enabler of our global business strategy. As a leading international semiconductor company, we operate in a complex, fast-moving environment where high quality legal advice truly matters. We are looking for an experienced Senior Legal Counsel who combines strong corporate and M&A expertise with business acumen and a collaborative mindset.

About the role

In this senior role you:

- Provide corporate legal support and ensure corporate compliance for the global Nexperia group, including Nexperia Germany and the Hamburg site (which includes corporate housekeeping and ESG).
- Act as secretary to the Nexperia Germany Board of Directors.
- Support the Deputy Chief Legal Officer ("DCLO") on specific matters in strategic corporate projects, such as in the field of Corporate/M&A, Finance, Tax and Treasury (which includes M&A, investments, strategic co-operations (incl R&D), intercompany agreements, treasury and insurance matters).
- Deliver commercial legal support to certain key customers under the supervision of the DCLO.
- Are managing disputes, litigation and claims (such as distributors, local suppliers etc).
- Are managing outside legal counsel and legal spend.
- Support the German Corporate Affairs department.

The role is based at our office in Hamburg, and you will report directly to the Deputy Chief Legal Officer.

What you will need

The ideal candidate has 6-10 years of relevant experience as a corporate lawyer or (in-house) legal counsel and is ready to further apply and deepen their expertise in an international environment.

Furthermore, you have:

- A completed university degree in law.
- A truly international mindset and have excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal).
- Strong knowledge of and experience in corporate law and ESG in an international setting.
- Relevant experience gained at a leading law firm and/or a multinational company (considered as an advantage).
- M&A experience (considered a strong advantage).
- Experience working closely with Finance, Treasury and/or Tax departments.
- Litigation experience (considered an advantage).
- Proven experience working with C‑suite and senior management stakeholders.

About the job

To strengthen our R&D organization, we are looking for an Automation & AI Specialist (m/f/d) who translates business requirements into scalable automation and AI supported solutions and actively contributes to improving the efficiency of our R&D processes. You will be directly involved in shaping the digitalization, automation, and AI enablement of R&D processes in an international, technology driven environment.

What you will do

- Translate R&D business and user requirements into effective system, process, and automation solutions
- Design, implement, test, and continuously improve automated workflows, AI-augmented data flows and AI Agents
- Ensure stable data flows, high data quality, and reliable system operations
- Operate and further develop R&D collaboration and workflow tools (e.g. SharePoint, monday.com, SwiftKanban), including hands on application support
- Actively support change adoption through structured onboarding, release communication and user enablement
- Work closely with Nexperia IT, internal stakeholders, and external partners

What you will need

- University degree in business administration, computer science, engineering, or a comparable technical discipline
- Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in a comparable position, depending on educational credentials
- Strong understanding of business process and R&D process automation
- Practical experience with scripting languages (e.g. Python, VBA); deeper software development skills are a plus
- Knowledge of data integration and data exchange, e.g. between SAP applications and other systems
- Hands on experience with collaboration and workflow tools such as SharePoint, monday.com, or comparable platforms
- Strong communication and networking skills and proficiency in German and English (written and spoken)
- Structured, solution oriented working style with a strong focus on quality
- Service oriented, reliable team player with a high level of flexibility combined with accountability and commitment.

About the role

As a Project Manager for complex R&D and engineering programs, you will take end to end ownership of high impact, multi-site projects that shape our future product portfolio. You will operate at the intersection of advanced technology, global collaboration, and business success, driving projects from concept to execution while balancing quality, timing, cost, and risk.

This is your new job

Lead and Deliver Complex Projects

- Take full accountability for the execution of complex multi-site R&D and engineering projects
- Define and drive the overall project plan in alignment with key stakeholders and management up to executive level
- Ensure project delivery within agreed specification, quality, cost, timeline, and reporting boundaries

- Provide clear leadership, operational guidance, and constructive conflict management

Master Risk, Change, and Decision Making

- Establish and lead the change management process for scope, cost, and timeline changes

Strengthen the Organization

- Coach and support other Project Leaders through peer exchange and reviews
- Contribute to the project management knowledge base by sharing lessons learned, best practices, and proven methodologies
- Actively drive continuous improvement in project execution to meet business targets and reduce time to market

What you will need

- University degree in a technical field or other relevant discipline
- Minimum 5 years of project management experience in semiconductors or related technical environment
- Strong hands-on experience with modern project management tools and methods
- Solid capability in planning, scheduling, budgeting, scope, risk, change, and stakeholder management
- Experience managing cross domain teams and external partners
- Semiconductor process and package knowledge is a strong advantage
- PMI or comparable project management certification is beneficial
- Proven leadership in building and guiding project teams in a global, intercultural environment
- Strong sense of ownership and accountability – you deliver on commitments and remove obstacles
- Clear customer and business orientation, with a constant focus on reducing time to market
- Excellent communication and negotiation skills in English, confident working with senior and executive stakeholders

About the job

As Volume Product Manager you will be part of our Diodes & Transistors Product Management Team. Together with four ambitious and motivated Product Managers in our team, you will take the full responsibility of our Diodes & Transistors strategy.

What you will do

- Act as the go-to-person for all industrial projects and strategic questions in terms of cost downs, outsourcing and 2nd source activities
- Define an industrial strategy, start and support initiatives, guide Business Group internal as well as front-end and back-end teams
- Responsible for PCN implementation, roadmap updates and cost benchmarking
- Work closely together with Operations, Volume Product Management Protection & Filtering as well as Commercial Marketing
- Cooperate with our wafer fabs, assembly sites as well as subcontractors around the globe
- Support long term planning, deep dive and other business reviews and strategic activities
- Align closely on operational processes for Diodes & Transistors with Demand Management and Supply Chain

What you will need

- University degree in a technical discipline
- Minimum 5 years of relevant working experience in Product Management, Operations or Development function within the semiconductor industry
- Direct or indirect leadership experience in leading international / cross-cultural teams
- Excellent communication skills and proven track record in managing cross-functional projects 
- Preferably knowledge of semiconductor markets, customers and/or supply chains
- Excellent decision-making skills
- Excellent analytical skills and structured work approach
- Highly self-motivated, team-oriented, result-driven
- Strong customer mindset and interest in global supply chains
- Excellent Microsoft Office skills, including Excel & PowerPoint
- Fluent in English mandatory, German language is a plus

jobs.occupation: Principal Product Application Engineer (m/f/d) – Diodes & Transistors (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
About the job

As Principal Product Application Engineer, you will be responsible for the Application Strategy and Application Knowledge management for our Diodes & Transistors portfolio. In addition to technical support for our leading customers from the automotive, industrial and consumer industries, you are our main interface to our Product Management and R&D teams in order to build up a future proof product portfolio.

What you will do

- Qualify the value of Nexperia's products (strengths versus competitive products) and quantify the technical benefits derived from choosing Nexperia
- Take the lead for product requirements based on application insights
- Represent Nexperia’s application perspective in technical comities and Standardization groups as well as establishing and maintaining technical contacts to key decisions makers and influencers like Car OEMs and reference design houses and of course Industry Lead Customers
- Translate application expertise and customer insights into “customer requirement specifications” and build a future proof product portfolio
- Conduct product investigations and circuit analysis on application level
- Set up demo boards and represent the Nexperia Diodes & Transistors group at trade fairs

What you will need

- University degree in electrical engineering or other related technical discipline
- Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience in the semiconductor industry or in a related business
- Ideally proven experience within the Automotive/Industrial/Consumer Electronics environment
- Development and Engineering experience, as well as hardware design know how

“The Martian Mindset - A scarcity-driven engineering paradigm” is a newly funded Cluster of Excellence and was established at the University of Bremen in 2026. In this context, a position is available as soon as possible, as a

Research Assistant (f/m/d) salary scale (German) 13 TV-L, 100 % (39.2 h per week)

limited until 30.6.2029 according to § 2 WissZeitVG.

Part-time work is generally possible and to be agreed with the respective project leaders.

The workplace and employment will be at the University of Bremen, Center of Applied Space Technology and Microgravity (ZARM) in the research group of Prof. Dr. Marc Avila. The University as an Employer:

With approximately 20,000 students and about 3,500 employees, the University of Bremen is a medium-sized university. It ranks among Germany’s leading universities in terms of external funding and research.

The Martian Mindset:

Our scientists are developing the “Martian Mindset” in order to rethink the production of materials and components from scratch. The scarcity of resources and extreme conditions on the red planet serve as a setting to develop a new paradigm of sustainability that will lay the foundations for a fossil-fuel-free production of materials and parts from scarce resources in a highly automated and resilient way. The Cluster of Excellence will thus contribute to the sustainable human exploration of space and power a green transition on Earth.

The challenging and interdisciplinary research in “The Martian Mindset” spans ten multifaceted foci across three areas, whereas this position is to be filled within the Research Area 1, Sourcing:

In this research area, we investigate how to produce high-added-value materials and chemicals from low-grade ores using atmospheric gases as the only source of carbon and nitrogen and without burning fossil fuels. The focus of this position falls under modelling and simulation of multiphase flows electrolysis systems.

This project aims at developing numerical models that faithfully describe the generation, detachment and interaction of bubbles in electrolytes. The initial focus is on the generation of oxygen in water electrolysis under terrestrial and Mars conditions, but the models developed will offer a robust framework extendable to molten salt electrolysis.

The gas dynamics in electrochemical cells spans multiple scales in space, from (sub)nanometer to cell size (mm), and similarly for time, which cannot be all resolved simultaneously. Accordingly, multiscale, multiphase models will be developed that parametrize the effect of the unresolved (small) scales. Results from other projects in the Cluster that focus on the nano and micro scales will be leveraged to inform parametrizations and/or train the models with machine-learning techniques. A central focus is the quantification of uncertainty in the multi-scale approach. The resulting model predictions will directly inform reactor design and optimization in collaboration with experimental groups in the Cluster.

This project enhances the “Martian Mindset” scarcity-driven engineering paradigm by paving the way for the accurate, robust design of electrochemical technologies on Earth and in space conditions.

More information on the other research foci, the project leaders and the Cluster of Excellence itself can be found on our website: www.mars.uni-bremen.de.

As a researcher in The Martian Mindset, working at one of the five participating institutions on the campus of the University of Bremen, you will join a vibrant and dynamic scientific community of internationally renowned researchers. You will be involved in innovative and challenging scientific projects and contribute to the advancement of the respective research field.

Your key tasks will include in particular:

• Develop mathematical multiscale, multiphase models of the gas dynamics in electrochemical cells

• Implement these models using python and CUDA based on our in-house codes

• Parametrize and train the models leveraging nano- and microscopic data from other numerical and in the Cluster

• Validate results with experiments performed in other projects in the Cluster

• Investigate the dependence of the gas dynamics on the parameters of the system (electrode material and surface roughness, potential, concentration of the electrolyte, etc.)

• Documenting, publishing, and presenting research findings through various channels, including academic journals and international conferences, usually in English

• Collaborating with PhD students, postdoctoral researchers to advance joint scientific projects and publications

• Actively participating in Martian Mindset events, such as retreats, seminars, summer schools, and workshops to foster knowledge sharing and collaboration, considering individual possibilities (e.g. compatibility with family responsibilities, impairments)

• Mandatory participation in our qualification program (see below)

• Developing and writing grant proposals to secure funding for research projects and initiatives

• After agreement, there is the possibility of performing teaching tasks independently

• Opportunity to pursue individual academic research (e.g., doctoral dissertation, habilitation, or work equivalent to a habilitation)

Requirements

We are looking for dynamic and open-minded personalities who enjoy conducting cutting-edge research in an interdisciplinary, international and diverse team. To succeed in this role, you should

• old a master’s degree in a relevant field such as Applied Mathematics, Physics, Aerospace/Mechanical/Chemical/Process Engineering or a related discipline.

• We also consider applicants who are in the final phase of their master’s degree program. Please note that submission of your master’s degree certificate is mandatory for employment.

• be proficient in English (spoken and written), e.g. CEF-level B2

• demonstrate the ability to work independently and manage time effectively

• show team spirit

• possess a collaborative mindset and strong communication skills

• exhibit analytical thinking and problem-solving skills

A willing to engage in interdisciplinary work and collaborate with colleagues from different fields of expertise is expected.

We offer:

• State-of-the-art, unique research infrastructure

• Opportunities for international collaborations and extended research stays in top laboratories around the world

• A comprehensive mentoring and qualification program (see below) tailored to your individual needs and goals to promote successful project completion and transition to leading positions in academia and industry

• Support from the Welcome Center of the U Bremen Research Alliance

• Depending on individual qualifications, a gross annual salary in accordance with the TV-L ranging from 57.112,44 € (Level 1) to 81.176,28 € (Level 6) for a full-time position (39.2 hours per week).

The university will determine the individual pay grade assignment based on relevant prior professional experience upon an offer of employment. Additional benefits, such as the annual bonus (“Christmas bonus”) and any career advancement opportunities within the advertised pay grade, are also dependent on this assignment. This is based on the applicable legal provisions of the TV-L (specifically § 16 TV-L). For civil servants, remuneration is governed in particular by the provisions of the Bremen Civil Service Remuneration Act (further information can be found here).

• An additional pension plan for public sector employees (VBL)

Qualification concept

Together we will create an exceptional environment for research, education and innovation, where the Martian Mindset can flourish. Our qualification concept is designed to empower early-career researchers to become creative, versatile and responsible risk-takers, who will continue to develop and implement our scarcity driven engineering paradigm in leadership roles within academia and industry. To achieve this, we offer individualized supervision and training, with a strong advisory network of supervisors, mentors, and peers. Further information on our comprehensive qualification program is available online.

For general questions about the personnel selection procedure and for questions about the content of the advertised position, please do not hesitate to contact:

Prof. Dr. Marc Avila (mavila@uni-bremen.de)

or our recruiting team (MartianMindset.applications@uni-bremen.de)

For more information on the research foci and project leaders, the training program, the participating institutions, and the selection process, please visit our website: www.mars.uni-bremen.de (https://www.uni-bremen.de/die-marsperspektive)
